faq.q1: What's the difference between an inspection and a repair visit?
faq.a1: On an inspection a technician looks at the problem and gives you a price. On a repair visit the team comes prepared to fix the specific problem you described.
faq.q2: How much does an inspection cost?
faq.a2: We'll tell you the inspection price when we confirm by phone.
faq.a3: Yes. The confirmation email has a cancellation link.
faq.a4: On site, once the work is done.
